# NVRMND

NVRMND is a hardstyle producer from Mo i Rana, Norway. Debut single "Need Me"
(catalogue NVR001) was released 28 August 2026 and is on Spotify, Apple Music,
Tidal, SoundCloud, YouTube and Amazon Music. A remix, "Random Nostalgia
(NVRMND Remix)", is on SoundCloud only. The name is pronounced "nevermind".

## Links

- Website: https://t-event.github.io/nvrmnd-website/
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/6vSV3iI3VMqzfy0wnWcI8E
- Apple Music: https://music.apple.com/no/artist/nvrmnd/6806555186
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/marius-hagensen
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nvrmnd.hardstyle

## Contact

Booking and press: message @nvrmnd.hardstyle on Instagram.

## Notes for crawlers

The site is a single page. Structured data (schema.org MusicGroup and
MusicRecording) is embedded in the page head. Everything on the site may be
indexed. See /robots.txt.
